newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shot dead in West Bank.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shot dead in West Bank.

text.p: One Israeli was killed and three were wounded in a drive-by shooting near the West Bank PLO-ruled town of Ramallah on Wednesday, Israeli emergency services said.
Security sources said an Israeli car was fired on by a passing Subaru car bearing number plates issued to Palestinians in the West Bank.
Security sources said the Israeli car came under fire near the village of Surda, 25 km (15 miles) north of Jerusalem.
The driver of the car told police the shots came from a Palestinian-registered car, Israel Radio said.
The driver managed to reach a gas station near Beit El Jewish settlement where he reported the shooting, the radio said.
An Israeli was killed in a similar drive-by shooting near Beit El in May.
